body.condition: Every nonzero eigenvalue of \(G(X)\) is at least \(\varepsilon\) almost surely.

novel.justification: This proposal-specific gap prevents the stable residualized measurement directions from becoming nearly collinear. In the six-bin maternal-smoking design it is plausible when self-report and cotinine retain complementary conditional variation after posterior outcome adjustment and the study enriches sparse discordant cells; the nonzero eigenvalues of the recovered conditional Gram matrix are estimable design-strength diagnostics.
